messages:
Morgan: Morning async — what I did: finished rate-limiter quota refactor and updated the policy optimizer.
Morgan: Blockers: staging tests failing with header parsing errors (Authorization header sometimes arrives as "auth_token").
Morgan: Today: fix parser, start canary rollout for new rate strategy to 10% traffic, need runbook/rollback owner and CR review. Ping @Alex @Sam
Alex: I can own the rollback runbook. Can you drop the quick rollback steps in this thread? also PR #4578 has a small rename I noticed.
Morgan: Rollback snippet:
```
# rollback canary
route weight set gw-service v1 100
disable feature rate_strategy_v2
# ensure cache flush: curl -X POST $ADMIN/flush
```
Morgan: Also snippet of failing parse:
```
if 'Authorization' in headers:
    token = headers.get('Authorization')
else:
    token = headers.get('auth_token')  # staging sends this for legacy clients
```
Sam: I'll review PR #4578 this afternoon. quick Q: will this change affect cookie-based sessions or only header tokens?
Morgan: Only header tokens. No cookie changes. We forward tokens to auth service unchanged. @Tara can you confirm token-forwarding in staging?
Tara: Confirmed — auth proxy forwards token header, but I saw ~2% 401s on staging during load tests. I can triage post-10am, will check logs and map to client version.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging rollout for rate-strategy-v2 at 14:00 UTC — https://deploys.example.com/rollouts/1234
Alex: ack :thumbsup: I'll assemble the rollback doc and add checklists (smoke tests, latency SLOs, cache invalidation). Also let's add CI job `rate-limiter-integration` to run against staging nightly.
Sam: LGTM once tests are green. I'll add extra logging around header parsing to capture malformed values.
Morgan: handing CR to Sam, runbook to Alex. Tara to triage auth errors. No blockers after Tara confirms. Thanks all :rocket:
